similar_in_english: to make a name for oneself
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কাজের জন্য সারা দেশে নাম হয়ে গেছে।
এই ঘটনার পর তার নাম হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: His work has made him famous throughout the country.
After this incident, he became well-known.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural value placed on reputation and recognition in Bengali society.
